_comment: Copy this file to scripts/forbidden-names.local.json (gitignored) and fill in your real org identifiers. Categories: (1) scannerPatterns — regex patterns matched against every tracked file (org names, community names, usernames, feature-flag slugs); (2) patterns — alias for scannerPatterns (back-compat); (3) historyTerms — plain string terms for git-history scan (--git-history flag). Use \b word-boundary anchors and escape dots for domains.
